issues.reason: The complement is wholly negative ('had NOT exhausted'), and the instruction set registers that a seal has no polarity carrier — 'seal what is expressible and leave the negated conjunct out ... not a licence to assert the positive form' — so leaving it out is the prescribed behaviour here, not a defect.

Names and casing makes the Name fact mandatory for a mentioned proper noun ('neither part is optional') and the atom is true and well-typed; being unreferenced follows from the licensed omission above and puts nothing false, ill-typed or over-asserted in the KB.

Categorical statements: a 'definite / demonstrative / possessed plural ... takes a group witness — (GroupOf <group> <kind>)', so encoding 'his remarks' as the single individual (Member sk_remark_1 remark) misstates the referent's number.

The half that stands is that the genitive rule names Possession / PartOf for a possessive pronoun, so the parse departs from its letter; the defect half does not stand — (Agent sk_remark_1 sk_person_1) is true of the sentence and well-typed on a witness the instruction set itself treats as an eventuality (Past and Time attach directly to an event-noun), so no repair is licensed.

gaps_confirmed: a finite that-clause complement of a NOUN ('his remarks ... that P') — clausal complements are specified only for attitude, perception and embedded-question verbs, and the complements section covers argument PPs only
the maker / subject of an event-denoting noun ('his remarks') — the genitive rule offers only Possession / PartOf and no route for who made the remark
new_gaps: compounded with gap 1: even if the noun's that-clause were sealed, its content here is a negation, which a seal cannot carry — so the construction is doubly unrepresentable, not merely unrouted

a possessed plural that is also an event-noun: GroupOf makes the referent a group while the light-verb rule wants that same witness to BE the eventuality carrying Past / Time / Agent, and nothing reconciles the two

'in an interview' — an occasion NP as the object of 'in': Location is defined for 'in / at / on', During renders only the word 'during', and the preposition-named oblique is the residue; no rule decides which an event-denoting object takes
repair_summary: Changed (Member sk_remark_1 remark) to (GroupOf sk_remark_1 remark) so the possessed plural is a group witness; every other atom, symbol name and line order is unchanged.
notes: The dropped content clause and the resulting orphan ECB name are one consequence of a single registered limitation (no polarity inside a seal), which is why both objections are refuted rather than repaired.
